source: &188 We were all up in the bedroom earlier this evening...
target: &188 今晚早些时候，我们都在楼上的卧室里……

source: &1 You're worrying too much!
target: &1 你想得太多了！

source: &1 You promised me that you'd gotten out of it!
target: &1 你答应过我，已经不再掺和了！

source: &2 I have, this was merely a...favor. For an old friend.
target: &2 是不再掺和了，这只是……帮个忙。帮一位老朋友。

source: &2 And look where it's gotten you!
target: &2 你看看，结果弄成了什么样！

source: &189 They were arguing about something. It sounded big!
target: &189 他们在争论什么。听起来是件大事！

source: &3 Don't you think I know what this could mean?
target: &3 你以为我不知道这意味着什么吗？

source: &4 You asked me to talk to that damned CEL agent, and I agreed.
target: &4 你让我跟那个该死的CEL探员谈谈，我也答应了。

source: &5 You see what I do for you?
target: &5 看看我为你做了些什么？

source: &3 I know, and I knew you'd do the right thing eventually.
target: &3 我知道。我也知道，你最终会做对的事。

source: &6 It's not just because it's the right thing, or because you asked.
target: &6 不只是因为这是对的，或是因为你开了口。

source: &7 It's because of what it would mean to the whole city...
target: &7 更因为它对整座城市意味着什么……

source: &190 Mr Giel was grumpy, but not at Mr Dakarai so much.
target: &190 吉尔先生脾气不好，可并不怎么针对达卡莱先生。

source: &191 Then he asked for some of his special wine.
target: &191 然后，他就要喝那种特制的酒。

source: &192 Chantelle! Be a dear, bring me my wine.
target: &192 尚特尔！亲爱的，把我的酒拿来。

source: &1472 This was the lousy stuff they've got in the wine rack?
target: &1472 就是酒架上那些劣质酒？

source: &8 To law and order!
target: &8 为法律与秩序干杯！

source: &193 Yeah, but he puts extra things in his wine as well.
target: &193 是的，不过他还会往酒里加些别的东西。

source: &9 Agh!
&4 Giel, what's wrong?
target: &4 吉尔，你怎么了？

source: &11 Must have been my...
target: &11 肯定是我的……

source: &12 What...what is this?!
target: &12 这……这是什么？！

source: &5 What's what?
target: &5 什么是什么？

source: &194 Mr Giel seemed to be real worried about something.
target: &194 吉尔先生好像在为什么事特别担心。

source: &13 Who are you?!
&6 Giel, what are you doing with that gun?
target: &6 吉尔，你拿枪干什么？

source: &14 Stay away! Don't come any closer!
target: &14 离我远点！别过来！

source: &15 Agh! NO! Get off me!
target: &15 啊！不！放开我！

source: &16 Chantelle!
target: &16 尚特尔！

source: &195 He sounded like he was in trouble.
target: &195 听起来，他遇到了麻烦。

source: &17 Get it out of me!
target: &17 把它从我身体里弄出去！

source: &196 He kept telling me there was something in him. I asked what he meant.
target: &196 他一直说，身体里有什么东西。我就问他是什么意思。

source: &18 It's inside me! Get in there, and get it out!
target: &18 它在我里面！进去，把它弄出来！

source: &1473 ...and the maid's personality...
target: &1473 ……而女仆的人格……

source: &1474 She'd have done anything he asked...
target: &1474 他无论叫她做什么，她都会照做……

source: &197 I didn't find anything, though.
target: &197 可是，我什么也没找到。
